title: Interaction support manuscript: proof, primary comparison and publication assessment
main_candidate_contribution: The sharp generic comparison interaction rank J(s)=Theta((3*sqrt(3)/2)^s/sqrt(s)), the resulting bounded-error face-dimension law, and their exact sparse-certificate/generic-state-fan interpretation.
observation_model: Face words contain labeled exponent vectors, not numerical prime values and not projected initial streams. Coordinate labels need not be in increasing numerical prime order.
Bounds are uniform over ambient dimension. Prime examples may depend on the requested finite prefix and may use very large bases.
The sparse interval certificate starts from an exactly replayed strict rational center and reads the full prefix plus border. It is separate from the CLI independent rank auditor.
